definitions.explanation: The flat green parts of a plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{色|いろ}づいてきた→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧。
examples.english: The tree leaves have started turning red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, lots of new leaves appear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}だ→大変：00594_taihen⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, all the leaves on the trees in the garden fall, and cleaning up every day is hard work.
In summer the leaves are lush and create shade, so I like to rest under this tree.

notes:
{葉|は} means leaf or leaves, a basic nature vocabulary word.

PRONUNCIATION:
- ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: standalone or in some compounds
- ば: in certain compounds (⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧, ⟦{青葉|あおば}→青葉：20092_aoba⟧)
- よう: on'yomi reading (⟦{葉緑素|ようりょくそ}→葉緑素：22631_youryokuso⟧)

SEASONAL TERMS:
- ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧: fresh green leaves (spring)
- ⟦{青葉|あおば}→青葉：20092_aoba⟧: green/verdant leaves (early summer)
- ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧/⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧: autumn leaves/foliage
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧: fallen leaves
- ⟦{枯|か}れ{葉|は}→枯れ葉：20386_kareha⟧: dead/withered leaves

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{葉書|はがき}→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧: postcard (originally written on leaves)
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: word, language
- ⟦{木|こ}の{葉|は}→木の葉：10668_konoha⟧: tree leaves
- ⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧: leaf (casual/childish)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧: leaves are lush
- {葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧: leaves fall/scatter

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧: branch
- ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧: root
- ⟦{幹|みき}→幹：04364_miki⟧: trunk
